hero_sub: A practical AI roadmap for turning GIOK Insurance Agency's lead follow-up, CRM activity, and multi-product insurance conversations into a faster, more consistent system for booking qualified consultations.
profile_note: GIOK Insurance Agency is a growth-stage life and health insurance agency led by Jake Wagoner. The intake points to a solo operator with meaningful marketing spend, GoHighLevel already in place, and a clear constraint: more lead flow and faster lead follow-up.

results.title: You can use AI to protect response time, organize follow-up, and improve consultation readiness.
results.sub: The practical opportunity is not replacing your licensed judgment. It is using AI to answer quickly, collect clean context, keep the CRM current, and make sure you spend your time with prospects who are ready for a real coverage conversation.

cards.title: New inquiries get handled before they go cold
cards.desc: Life and health insurance shoppers often compare several options. A speed-to-lead layer can acknowledge the inquiry, confirm the coverage category, and route the prospect to you quickly without giving policy advice.

cards.title: Stalled prospects keep moving
cards.desc: Follow-up is your stated time drain. AI can keep a helpful sequence running across SMS and email, summarize responses, and surface the next best action inside GoHighLevel.

cards.title: Consultations start with better context
cards.desc: AI can gather basic intake context such as coverage type, state, timing, and preferred contact window so you start with cleaner information.

results.close: For GIOK Insurance Agency, the first AI win is a dependable front-end system around lead response, follow-up, and intake quality so you can focus on licensed consultation and closing.

ai_agents.name: Speed-to-Lead Insurance Agent
ai_agents.desc: Replies to new life and health insurance inquiries quickly, confirms the product need, and routes qualified prospects into the next consultation step.
ai_agents.prompt: You are a speed-to-lead assistant for GIOK Insurance Agency. When a new insurance inquiry arrives, respond in a warm, compliant tone, ask which coverage category they need, confirm state and timing, and propose the next consultation step without making policy or pricing promises.
ai_agents.result: New inquiries get a consistent first response before they drift to another agency.

ai_agents.name: Lead Follow-Up Agent
ai_agents.desc: Works unreplied and stalled prospects with a structured follow-up sequence across SMS and email.
ai_agents.prompt: You are a follow-up coordinator for GIOK Insurance Agency. Draft a three-touch follow-up sequence for a prospect who asked about life, health, Medicare, or mortgage protection coverage but has not booked. Keep the language helpful, concise, and consultation-focused.
ai_agents.result: Older leads are reactivated instead of sitting idle in the CRM.

ai_agents.name: Coverage Intake Agent
ai_agents.desc: Collects clean intake details before Jake spends time on a consultation.
ai_agents.prompt: You are an insurance intake assistant. Ask a prospect for the minimum helpful context before a licensed agent consult: coverage type, state, household situation, age range where appropriate, timing, and preferred contact window. Do not provide insurance advice.
ai_agents.result: Jake starts calls with cleaner context and fewer back-and-forth messages.

ai_agents.name: CRM Hygiene Agent
ai_agents.desc: Summarizes conversations, labels lead status, and flags the next action inside GoHighLevel.
ai_agents.prompt: You are a CRM operations assistant for GIOK Insurance Agency. Summarize the latest prospect interaction, classify the lead stage, identify the next action, and write a clean GoHighLevel note that a licensed agent can review quickly.
ai_agents.result: GoHighLevel stays usable as lead volume grows.

ai_agents.name: Referral Request Agent
ai_agents.desc: Turns completed consultations and happy clients into referral and review prompts.
ai_agents.prompt: You are a client follow-up assistant for an insurance agency. Draft a respectful referral and review request after a positive consultation or policy placement. Keep it personal, compliant, and low pressure.
ai_agents.result: Satisfied clients become a repeatable referral channel.

ai_agents.name: Content Repurposing Agent
ai_agents.desc: Turns common client questions into short educational posts for social and email.
ai_agents.prompt: You are a content assistant for GIOK Insurance Agency. Turn one common insurance question into a short educational post, a one-paragraph email, and three social captions. Avoid giving financial or insurance advice; invite readers to schedule a consultation with a licensed agent.
ai_agents.result: Jake can publish useful education without starting from a blank page.

prompts.title: Speed-to-Lead First Reply
prompts.subtitle: Use this when a new insurance inquiry enters GoHighLevel.
prompts.pre: You are a speed-to-lead response agent for GIOK Insurance Agency. A new prospect just asked about insurance coverage. Write a short SMS and email reply that thanks them, asks which coverage category they are interested in, confirms their state and preferred contact time, and invites them to a consultation with Jake Wagoner. Do not quote premiums, recommend a specific policy, or make coverage promises.
prompts.outcome: Every new inquiry gets a fast, compliant first touch.

prompts.title: Stalled Lead Follow-Up
prompts.subtitle: Use this for prospects who have not booked after the first reply.
prompts.pre: You are a follow-up coordinator for GIOK Insurance Agency. Create a three-touch follow-up sequence for a prospect who asked about life, health, Medicare, final expense, mortgage protection, dental, or vision coverage but has not booked. Keep each message helpful and brief. Ask one clear question per touch, route advice-sensitive questions to Jake Wagoner, and never imply approval, eligibility, or pricing.
prompts.outcome: Older leads get worked without manual copywriting.

prompts.title: GoHighLevel CRM Summary
prompts.subtitle: Use this after a call, text exchange, or form reply.
prompts.pre: You are a CRM hygiene assistant for GIOK Insurance Agency. Summarize this prospect interaction for GoHighLevel. Include coverage interest, state, urgency, missing details, current stage, recommended next action, and follow-up deadline. Keep the note concise enough for Jake Wagoner to scan quickly before a consultation.
prompts.outcome: The CRM stays clean and action-oriented.
